nodes.title: Meet Ruff
learn: Say which older tools Ruff replaces and what it costs you
Run Ruff with uvx or as a uv dev dependency
Read a finding: rule code, [*] fix mark, file, line and column
Use ruff rule and the exit code to understand a result

nodes.title: Rules & config
learn: Name the rule families behind F, E, W, I, UP, B and SIM
Shape the rule set with select, extend-select and ignore
Silence one finding with noqa or per-file-ignores
Move LevelUp's lint flags into pyproject.toml

nodes.title: Fixes & format
learn: Apply safe fixes with --fix and preview them with --diff
Explain why a fix like B006 is unsafe and opt in with care
Format code with ruff format and check it with --check
Sort imports with the I rules, since the formatter won't

nodes.title: Ruff everywhere
learn: Get findings as you type through the Ruff language server
Add the ruff-check and ruff-format pre-commit hooks in the right order
Fail a CI job on lint or format problems with GitHub notes
Adopt Ruff on an existing repo step by step, with a pinned version
